dct_title_s: Map Attached to Grant by the State of New Jersey to the Chelsea Investment and Development Comapany
dct_description_sm: Map covers area from Austin Avenue to Harrisburg Avenue along inside Thoroughfare.
Map shows the property of the Chelsea Investment Company in Atlantic City. Map also shows exterior wharf line and the high water line.
